meta.name: design-doctrine
meta.description: The house rules for ANY design or UI work - the verification protocol (run the gate, never claim a number), the absolute no-emoji rule, token by intent, one shared theme, the eight states, one thing leads, and output completeness. Load this FIRST whenever building, reviewing, or theming a screen, component, or token set. Installed as a plugin, this skill carries what CLAUDE.md carries in the repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动手做界面或组件前,先照这套规则核对状态、令牌与输出完整性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队需要一套统一的设计与界面验收规则并逐项落实。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs one shared set of design and UI acceptance rules to apply consistently.

howto.what: 做设计与 UI 时,Claude 会按一套固定规则行事:输出零 emoji、按用途选 token、全站共用一个主题、交互元素配齐八种状态,并在报告前先跑校验脚本,只报实测到的数字,没测就说尚未验证。
howto.when: 当你构建、审查或做主题化界面、组件、token 集时,它最先被加载并接管。

say.text: 帮我做一个按钮组件,跑完校验再报结果
say.note: 交付含八种状态的完整文件与实测结果

say.text: 审查这个页面的对比度和配色,没测就别给数字
say.note: 会运行门禁脚本并报告真实输出

say.text: 把全站换成统一暗色主题,不要写死颜色值
say.note: 从同一份 tokens 生成主题

howto.what_en: On any design or UI work Claude follows fixed rules: zero emoji, tokens picked by intent, one shared theme, eight states per control, and it runs gate scripts before reporting - citing only measured numbers, else "not verified yet".
howto.when_en: It loads first when you build, review, or theme a screen, component, or token set.

say_en.text: Build me a button component and run the gates before reporting
say_en.note: Delivers full files with eight states and real results

say_en.text: Review this page's contrast and colors - no unmeasured numbers
say_en.note: Runs the gate scripts and reports real output

say_en.text: Switch the whole app to one dark theme, no hardcoded colors
say_en.note: Renders theme from one shared tokens file
